description: Hand-written benchmark for the rubric scorer. Each pair expresses the SAME underlying request twice: once as a developer typically dashes it off, once written well. Pairing controls for topic, so a separation score reflects prompt quality rather than subject matter.

pairs.weak: the parser is broken, fix it
pairs.strong: Fix `parse_file` in backend/ingestion/jsonl_parser.py — it returns None for sessions whose first record has no `cwd`, so project_path stays unset. It should fall back to the first record that has one. Don't change the return shape; parse_file must still return a ParsedSession.

pairs.weak: can you add some tests, maybe a few for the scorer
pairs.strong: Write 3 pytest cases for `score_prompt` in backend/ml/rubric.py: empty string returns 0.0, a prompt hitting every signal returns 10.0, and a prompt hitting only clarity returns 2.5. Use plain asserts, no fixtures.

pairs.weak: the api is kind of slow, can you make it faster
pairs.strong: GET /api/sessions takes 1.8s with 400 sessions because it runs one score query per session. Rewrite it as a single grouped aggregate so it stays under 200ms. Return the same JSON shape — the dashboard depends on it.

pairs.weak: make the dashboard look better
pairs.strong: Raise the body text contrast on the session list in frontend/app/page.tsx to at least 4.5:1 — the current text-neutral-500 on bg-neutral-950 measures 3.1:1 and fails WCAG AA. Keep the existing dark palette; only change the foreground token.

pairs.weak: this file is messy, clean it up a bit
pairs.strong: Extract the duplicated cache-fingerprint logic in mcp_server/server.py and backend/routers/projects.py into one function in backend/reports.py, so the two callers can't drift. Behaviour must not change; both call sites should keep returning (payload, was_cached).

pairs.weak: i need an endpoint for the projects thing
pairs.strong: Add GET /api/projects returning a list of {project_path, name, prompt_count, avg_score} ordered by prompt_count descending, so the dashboard can list tracked folders. Follow the pattern in backend/routers/sessions.py; no new dependencies.

pairs.weak: its crashing again, something with dates i think
pairs.strong: Sorting in `collect` (backend/reports.py) raises TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes when any prompt has timestamp=None. SQLite returns naive datetimes; the fallback sentinel is timezone-aware. Fix the sort key so both cases work; don't touch the DB schema.

pairs.weak: make the db configurable or something
pairs.strong: Read the database URL from a DATABASE_URL env var in backend/db.py, defaulting to the current SQLite path when unset, so the same code runs on Postgres in production. Example: DATABASE_URL=postgresql+psycopg2://u:p@host/db.

pairs.weak: write docs
pairs.strong: Write a README section for the terminal CLI covering install, the six subcommands, and the auto-sync hook. Format as a markdown table of command → description, matching the style of the existing 'Key API Endpoints' section in HANDOVER.md.

pairs.weak: can we use a library for the caching stuff instead
pairs.strong: Replace the hand-rolled cache in frontend/lib/useQuery.ts with TanStack Query v5, so we get retries and devtools for free. Keep the same call sites — useQuery(key, fetcher, {staleMs}) — by writing a thin wrapper. Add @tanstack/react-query to package.json.

pairs.weak: the form should validate better
pairs.strong: Reject empty and whitespace-only notes in `NotesEditor.save` (frontend/components/NotesEditor.tsx) before the PATCH fires, showing 'Note cannot be empty' beneath the textarea. Currently it posts an empty string and the server stores it.

pairs.weak: add logging so i can debug it
pairs.strong: Log one line per imported session in scripts/import_jsonl.py at INFO: session id, prompt count, and whether it was created or updated. Use the stdlib logging module, not print, so the MCP server's stdio stays clean.

pairs.weak: we need to add a column
pairs.strong: Add a nullable `kind` VARCHAR(24) column to the prompts table. SQLAlchemy's create_all only creates missing tables, so it needs an explicit ALTER TABLE guarded by an inspector check in backend/db.py — safe to run repeatedly against an existing promptly.db.

pairs.weak: handle errors better in the extension
pairs.strong: In vscode-extension/extension.js, `errorHtml` renders the whole Python traceback into a narrow sidebar. Show only the last line as the summary and put the full text in a collapsed <details>. Escape the message — it is already passed through escapeHtml, keep that.

pairs.weak: something got slower recently
pairs.strong: build_report in backend/reports.py re-runs extract_signals over every prompt on each call, which is 400ms at 200 prompts. Memoize per prompt id, or precompute at ingest. Report output must stay byte-identical — there is a cached payload keyed on a fingerprint.

pairs.weak: add a flag to the cli
pairs.strong: Add `--since DAYS` to `promptly report` so it only counts prompts from the last N days. Default is unchanged (all time). Filter in `collect`, not in the renderer, so the JSON output honours it too.

pairs.weak: is this safe? maybe check the sql
pairs.strong: The LIKE pattern in `collect` (backend/reports.py) interpolates a filesystem path, and project paths routinely contain underscores, which LIKE treats as single-character wildcards. Escape %, _ and backslash, and pass escape='\\'. Add a test that /a/my_project does not match /a/myXproject.

pairs.weak: make it more accessible i guess
pairs.strong: Every icon-only button in frontend/components/ needs an accessible name. Add aria-label to the refresh button in app/projects/report/page.tsx and wrap it in the existing Tooltip component. Do not remove any focus rings.

pairs.weak: the numbers look wrong on the dashboard
pairs.strong: Skill-file injections are being scored as user prompts, so 5 of the top 6 'best prompts' are text the user never typed. Filter turns whose text starts with 'Base directory for this skill:' out of scoring. Show me the before/after counts.

pairs.weak: how do i deploy this
pairs.strong: Explain what changes to run the FastAPI backend on Fly.io with Postgres instead of local SQLite: which env vars, what to do about the SQLite-only check_same_thread connect arg, and whether the JSONL importer can still run. Answer as a numbered list, no code yet.
